correctness.rationale: For P=A_a ordinal-sum A_b, Hibi straightening relations split into the two Boolean sublattices sharing the top-of-first/bottom-of-second corner variable t, yielding affine Segre cone fiber product C_a x_{A1_t} C_b; Proj has dimension a+b. On nonzero Segre tensors, dt=0 exactly when at least two selected u_i factors vanish at t=0. Jacobian on the fiber product gives singular points with both tensors nonzero iff at least two such factors vanish on each side; single zero tensor is singular precisely when its cone dimension m>=2. Their closures are b boundary Segre B_j (a>=2), a boundary A_i (b>=2), and C(a,2)C(b,2) two-face projective joins. Dimensions and irreducibility follow from Segre face cones and joins; local coordinates give generic C_a/C_b transverse cones of multiplicity a!/b! or uv-wz node at mixed joins. Independently checked all 386 finite-coordinate points in a=b=2 with coords in {-1,0,1} satisfying the two defining quadrics: all Jacobian singularities agree with exactly the predicted five lines. This finite test does not prove arbitrary a,b.
